+title: Some HotResumeTests do not cancel the open prompt task of the tree when a step throws
+---
+## Problem
+
+`HotResumeTests.openPrompt(of:hold:)` starts an unstructured `prompt` task and keeps it in `LiveTree`. Some tests cancel it with `defer { tree.prompt.cancel() }`. Other tests do not, for example `aHotResumeDoesNotCancelTheOpenPrompt`, `theReplayAnnouncesTheChildBeforeItsHistory`, `theWireOfAHotResumeFollowsTheRulesOfTheValidator`, `theNewConnectionOwnsTheRootAfterAHotResume`, the tests on `startAskingTree()`, and the two tests of a failed hot resume. In these tests, when a step before `finish(_:observedBy:)` throws, the prompt task stays and the fixture does not close. This is the `swift/concurrency` rule: do not leak an unstructured `Task`.
+
+Found during ^s421j3d. That card changed only the reader of `resumeTrace(of:on:)`.
+
+## Work
+
+- [ ] Make sure that each test of `HotResumeTests` cancels the prompt task of its tree on each exit path, with one shared shape (for example a `defer` in each test, or a helper that owns the tree and cancels the prompt).
+- [ ] Do not change what the tests check. #acpa-6
\ No newline at end of file

+comments:
+- actor: claude-code
+  id: 01m7rtwt85kqvq2c09wk5xs72h
+  text: |-
+    Research:
+    - The leak had two sources. (1) 15 tests had no `defer { tree.prompt.cancel() }`. (2) `openPrompt(of:hold:)` and each `start*Tree()` helper made the prompt task and then did a wait that can throw. On a throw, no test got the tree, so no test could cancel the task.
+    - ResumeChildSyncTests already uses the correct shape: `startWork(of:)` cancels its task in a `catch`, and each test uses `defer { work.cancel() }`. This change uses the same shape.
+    - SubagentSessionsReplayTests, RedriveInterruptedRunsTests, RestoredRunStateTests and DirectoryMessageReplayTests start no unstructured `Task`. They do not have the problem.
+    - `TimedRead` does not fit here: it bounds a read that ends in the call, but the prompt task must stay open after the setup.
+    - `.closesHarnesses` closes the fixture when a test throws. The `defer` cancel runs before that close.
